title: The Basket of Warm Rolls
youtube_title: The Basket of Warm Rolls | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing a little can make two people feel expected.
summary: At a courtyard supper with a long table and a fig tree, Nils sees that a basket of warm rolls under a stripey cloth will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Nils makes a smaller, even share so Veda is included, and Grandpa Sol lets the choice stand without a speech.
